query:
SELECT employee_id,
                   (employee_id = $4
                    AND monthly_amount = $5::NUMERIC
                    AND currency = $6
                    AND effective_from = $7) AS "payload_matches!"
            FROM hr_employee_salary_rates
            WHERE tenant_id = $1
              AND created_by_account_id = $2
              AND idempotency_key = $3
